summary.en-US: The archive preserves both weak full-window tests and conditional recent-period observations.
summary.zh-CN: 归档同时保留完整窗口的弱结果与依赖近期市场阶段的观察。

title.zh-CN: 保留季频完整窗口结果

question.en-US: Can a recent final window outweigh the full record?
question.zh-CN: 最近最终窗口能否覆盖完整记录？

finding.en-US: All three pure-fundamental quarterly model lines were negative in the full test; none of six walk-forward windows had positive returns.
finding.zh-CN: 三条季频纯基本面模型线完整测试段均为负，六个滚动前推窗口没有正收益。

decision.en-US: Keep recent-window improvements as regime observations, not a replacement for the full record.
decision.zh-CN: 近期改善保留为市场阶段观察，不替换完整记录。

question.en-US: Does higher IC imply higher active return?
question.zh-CN: 较高 IC 是否意味着较高主动收益？

finding.en-US: The accrual-quality variant has higher IC but does not beat the baseline active return; financial-only has the strongest active return but negative IC.
finding.zh-CN: 应计质量变体 IC 较高却未超过基线主动收益；仅金融组主动收益最强，但 IC 为负。

decision.en-US: Retain sector attribution and concentration as competing explanations.
decision.zh-CN: 保留行业归因与集中度作为竞争解释。

question.en-US: Does archive integrity mean the strategy was revalidated?
question.zh-CN: 归档完整性是否等于策略重新验证？

finding.en-US: Twenty-six notes connect to frozen run records; restoration verified content, not a new training or portfolio replay.
finding.zh-CN: 26 篇笔记接入冻结运行记录；恢复验证的是内容完整性，没有重新训练或回放。

decision.en-US: Keep Hong Kong evidence historical and separate from A-share transfer claims.
decision.zh-CN: 港股证据保留为历史归档，不外推为 A 股有效性。

title.zh-CN: 月频行业诊断：主动收益

context.en-US: Recorded 24m/full monthly comparison, 2026-04-13. Five distinct variants; not quarterly tests or annualized returns.
context.zh-CN: 2026-04-13 记录的月频 24m/full 对照。五个不同变体；不是季频测试或年化收益。

interpretation.en-US: Financial-only return can be high while cross-sectional IC is negative; sector regime and concentration matter.
interpretation.zh-CN: 仅金融组收益高而截面 IC 为负，行业阶段与集中度值得检查。

context.en-US: Same five-line archive table; these are reported IC values, not the A-share forecast Rank IC measure.
context.zh-CN: 同一归档五线表；为原文记录的 IC，不是 A 股财务预测 Rank IC。

interpretation.en-US: The signal and realized active return orderings differ.
interpretation.zh-CN: 信号与实现主动收益的排序不同。

next_question.en-US: Can any archived candidate survive a new market window with matched sector and execution controls?
next_question.zh-CN: 归档候选能否在新的市场窗口及匹配行业、执行控制下保留？

before.zh-CN: 近期最终窗口亮点较好。

trigger.en-US: Full quarterly tests and all six walk-forward windows were weak.
trigger.zh-CN: 完整季频测试及六个前推窗口均弱。

after.en-US: Recent performance is a regime observation and does not replace the full record.
after.zh-CN: 近期表现是阶段观察，不能替换完整记录。

before.zh-CN: 仅金融组主动收益看似最强。

trigger.en-US: The same monthly diagnostic reports negative financial-only IC.
trigger.zh-CN: 同一月频诊断记录仅金融组 IC 为负。

after.en-US: Retain sector and concentration attribution; do not infer a superior ranking signal.
after.zh-CN: 保留行业与集中度归因，不推断更优排序信号。
